claims.claim: The fixed research pilot contains 204 queries, 15,000 passages, and 1,492 grade-1 qrels across independent economics and psychology tracks.
Seven learned-sparse models have per-track results for five quality metrics on the shared pilot.
Pairwise statements require query-aligned 10,000-sample intervals that exclude zero; intervals crossing zero remain uncertain.
Four predeclared slice dimensions and 13 bins per track are available; bins with n<10 are descriptive only.
The tracked package contains 24 opaque disagreement/failure cases without canonical identifiers or source text.
The portfolio covers neural/neural and static-query/document-expansion routes with distinct sparsity and encoding profiles.
claims.scope_or_reason: Measured at the frozen revisions and protocol

claims.claim: Snapshot, nnz, encoding throughput, CSR bytes, exact-search time, VRAM, and encoding-observed RSS can inform bounded maintenance choices.
claims.scope_or_reason: RSS is not a whole-cell peak; no production SLA

claims.claim: SciPy CSR exact sparse inner product is the quality ground truth for the fixed pilot.
claims.scope_or_reason: Small native corpus and CPU implementation

claims.claim: On the pinned Milvus 3.0.0 matrix, SINDI and DAAT_MAXSCORE exhibit workload/configuration-dependent QPS crossovers.
claims.scope_or_reason: Pinned build, hardware, and matrix only

claims.claim: SINDI serialized indexes are larger in all 12 paired accepted system cells.
claims.scope_or_reason: Serialized index bytes, not total cost

claims.claim: SPLADE-Tiny remains local research-only because standalone license evidence is incomplete; the dataset publication gate is closed.
claims.scope_or_reason: No weight or dataset redistribution authorization

claims.claim: BM25 and BGE-M3 long-dense results provide contextual anchors on the same raw pilot, candidates, qrels, and metrics.
claims.scope_or_reason: Not the complete S-009 cross-paradigm comparison; dense uses a different token cap

claims.claim: The measured results establish multilingual effectiveness or verified zero-shot behavior.
claims.scope_or_reason: Both tracks are English and training overlap is unknown

claims.claim: One model is the universal learned-sparse winner.
claims.scope_or_reason: Track/metric orders differ and many intervals cross zero

claims.claim: SINDI is universally faster or smaller than DAAT_MAXSCORE.
claims.scope_or_reason: QPS ratios cross one and every measured SINDI index is larger

claims.claim: The 100k/1M generated workloads demonstrate model-quality gains.
The phase-one results establish a production SLA or deployment recommendation valid across systems.
claims.scope_or_reason: No production environment or SLA study

claims.claim: A cross-track micro-average or total ordering is valid.
claims.scope_or_reason: Independent candidate pools and explicit no-aggregation policy
